heading: One big feature. Four supporting acts.
subtext: Lead with your strongest capability, then back it up with a grid of supporting features.

items.title: Config-driven rendering
items.description: The entire page is defined in JSON. Sections, variants, copy, images — all in structured config files. Agents can write them, humans can edit them.

items.title: 38 curated themes
items.description: Each with light and dark mode. Swap themes globally or per-page with a single config value.

items.title: 81 components
items.description: Across 8 categories. Heroes, features, forms, footers, navbars, galleries, and more.

items.title: Zero JS runtime
items.description: All components render at build time. No client hydration, no JS frameworks in the browser.

items.title: SEO built in
items.description: Per-page metadata, sitemap generation, robots.txt, and OG image support in every config.
